(a) age: Mat.6:27, Luk.12:25 (R, mg.), Heb.11:11; __(b) full age, maturity: Jhn.9:21, 23, Eph.4:13. __2. stature: Luk.19:3 (Mat.6:27, Luk.12:25, AV, R, txt.; but the prevailing usage in LXX and π. favours the former meaning in these doubtful passages; cf., Ellic., ICC, AR, on Eph, l.with; Milligan, NTD, 74 f., and esp., MM, Exp., xv; e contra, Field, Notes, 6).† (AS)

1757.full: ὁμοίως (ὅμοιος), adv., likewise, in like manner, equally: Mat.22:26, Mrk.4:16, Luk.10:37, al.; with dative, Mat.22:39, Luk.6:31; ὁ. καί, Mat.22:26, Mrk.15:31, al.; ὁ. καθώς, Luk.17:28; καθὼς . . . ὁ., Luk.6:31; ὁ. μέντοι καί, Ju 8 (AS)

s: Sidon, a maritime city of Phœnicia
1762.full: Σιδών, -ῶnος, ἡ (Heb. צִידוֹן), Sidon, a maritime city of Phœnicia: Mat.11:21-22 15:21, Mrk.3:8 7:24, 31, Luk.6:17 10:13-14, Act.27:3.† (AS)

1763.lxx: in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז
1763.full: αἶνος, ου, ὁ, [in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;] poët, and Ion., __1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.). __2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Mat.21:16 (LXX), Luk.18:43. __3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

1765.lxx: in LXX for עבר hi., etc.
1765.full: δι-άγω [in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;] __1. to carry over. __2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1Ti.2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tit.3:3.† (AS)

1766.lxx: in LXX for חֹק (Gen.47:22), (Pro.21:14 25:14), frequently in Sir.
1766.full: δόσις, -εως, ἡ (δίδωμι) [in LXX for חֹק (Gen.47:22), (Pro.21:14 25:14), frequently in Sir. ;] __1. properly, the act of giving: Php.4:15. __2. Objectively, a gift: Jas.1:17.† SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

1767.lxx: in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Job.5:22, Pro.29:9, al.
1767.full: κατα-γελάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Job.5:22, Pro.29:9, al. ;] to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), Mat.9:24, Mrk.5:40, Luk.8:53.† (AS)

1768.lxx: in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc.
1768.full: λανθάνω [in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;] to escape notice, be hidden (from): Mrk.7:24, Luk.8:47; with accusative of person(s), Act.26:26, 2Pe.3:5 3:8; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, Heb.13:2 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).† (AS)

1769.lxx: in LXX chiefly for יֶקֶב Num.18:27, al.; also for רַהַט (Gen.30:38, 41), גַּת (Neh.13:15, al.), etc.
1769.full: ληνός, -οῦ, ἡ (in some MSS., LXX and NT, ὁ), [in LXX chiefly for יֶקֶב Num.18:27, al.; also for רַהַט (Gen.30:38, 41), גַּת (Neh.13:15, al.), etc. ;] a trough or vat; esp. for the treading of grapes: Mat.21:33, Rev.14:20 19:16; τὴν λ. . . . τὸν μέγαν (a solecism perhaps inadvertent), Rev.14:19 (cf. ὑπολήνιον).† (AS)

s: of particular truths, or details, of the Christian revelation
1773.full: μυστήρισν, -ου, τό (μυέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dan.2:18 ff. (רָז), Tob.12:7, 11, Jdth.2:2, Wis.2:22 6:22 14:15, 23, Sir.3:18 22:22 27:16-17, 21, 2Ma.13:21 * ;] __1. that which is known to the μύστης (initiated), a mystery or secret doctrine, mostly in pl., τὰ μ. (Æsch., Hdt., al.). __2. In later writers (Menand., Incert., 168), that which may not be revealed (not, however, as in the modern sense, intrinsically difficult to understand), a secret or mystery of any kind (To, Jth, 2Mac, ll, with). __3. In NT, of the counsels of God (cf. Th.: Job.15:8, Psa.25:14 for סוֹד), once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof; __(a) of the Christian revelation generally : Rom.16:25, 1Co.2:7, Col.1:26-27, Eph.3:3, 9; τ. βασιλείας τ. θεοῦ, Mrk.4:11; τ. θεοῦ, 1Co.2:1, Rev.10:7; τ. θ., Χριστοῦ, Col.2:2; τ. Χριστοῦ., Col.4:3, Eph.3:4; τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, Eph.1:9; τ. εὐαγγελίον, Eph.6:19; τ. πίστεως, 1Ti.3:9; τ. εὐσεβείας, 1Ti.3:16; __(b) of particular truths, or details, of the Christian revelation : Rom.11:25, 1Co.15:51, Eph.5:32, 2Th.2:7, Rev.1:20 17:5, 7; pl., τὰ μ., 1Co.13:2 14:2; θεοῦ, 1Co.4:1; τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν (θεοῦ), Mat.13:11, Luk.8:10 (cf. Westc., Eph., 180 ff.; AR, Eph., 234 ff.; Lft., Col., 165 f.; Hatch, Essays, 57 f.; DB, iii, 465 ff.; DCG, ii, 213 ff.).† (AS)

1774.lxx: in LXX for הָבַל, שָׁוְא, etc.
1774.full: μάτην (prop. accusative of μάτη, a fault, folly), adv., [in LXX for הָבַל, שָׁוְא, etc. ;] in vain, to no purpose: Mat.15:9, Mrk.7:7" (LXX) .† (AS)

1775.full: ναῦς, νεώς accusative ναῦν, ἡ, [in LXX for עָנִי, אֲנִיָּה ;] a ship: Act.27:41 (elsewhere in NT always τ. πλοῖον; see M, Pro.25:1-28 f.; Bl., Gosp., 186 f.).† (AS)

1776.full: 1. to wash the hands or feet of another, (Odyssey by Homer):—;Mid., χεῖρας νίψασθαι to wash one's hands, (Iliad by Homer); so, νίψασθαι, absolute, to wash one's hands , (Odyssey by Homer), etc.; νίψασθαι ἁλός to wash [with water] from the sea, (Odyssey by Homer) 2. generally to purge, cleanse , (Sophocles Tragicus) 3. to wash off , ἱδρῶ νίψεν ἀπὸ χρωτός washed off the sweat from the skin, (Iliad by Homer); αἷμα νίζ᾽ ὕδατι (Iliad by Homer):—;Mid., χρόα νίζετο ἅλμην he washed the brine off his skin, (Odyssey by Homer):—;Pass., αἷμα νένιπται (Iliad by Homer)—;The word is commonly said of persons washing part of the person, while λούομαι is used of bathing , πλύνω of washing clothes . (ML)

1777.lxx: in LXX chiefly for שְׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.)
1777.full: πεδινός, -ή, -όν (πεδίον, a plain), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.) ;] level, plain: Luk.6:17.† (AS)

1779.lxx: in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi.
1779.full: πλατύνω (πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;] to make broad, enlarge, extend: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.23:5. Metaphorical (cf. Psa.119:32, al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, 2Co.6:11; ὑμεῖς, 2Co.6:13.† (AS)

1780.lxx: in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω)
1780.full: προσ-οχθίζω [in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;] to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3:10 (LXX), Heb.3:17.† (AS)

1782.full: a selling, sale , ὠνῇ τε καὶ πρήσι (ionic dative) χρέονται (Herdotus Historicus); ἐπὶ πρήσι for sale , (Herdotus Historicus); πρᾶσιν ποιεῖσθαι (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

1783.full: mostly in plural pieces of wood , rubbed one against another to produce fire, (Homeric Hymns), etc. (ML)

1784.full: σιαγών, -όνος, ἡ [in LXX for לְחִי ;] the jawbone, jaw, cheek: Mat.5:39, Luk.6:29 (cf. MM, xxii).† (AS)

1785.lxx: in LXX for פּוּץ hi., etc.
1785.full: σκορπίζω [in LXX for פּוּץ hi., etc. ;] in vernac. and in Ion, and late writers for σκεδάννυμι (see MM, xxiii; Rutherford, NPhr., 295), to scatter: ὁ λύκος, Jhn.10:12; ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει, Mat.12:30, Luk.11:23; pass., before εἰς, with accusative loc., Jhn.16:32; of one who dispenses blessings, 2Co.9:9 (LXX) (of. δια-σκορπίζομαι).† (AS)

1786.full: σοφίζω (σοφός), [in LXX chiefly for חָכָם ;] to make wise, instruct: with accusative of person(s), 2Ti.3:15 (cf. Psa.19:8 (Psa.119:98). As depon., -ομαι; __(a) intrans., to become wise (I2Ki.4:27 (3Ki.5:11), Ecc.2:15, and frequently in Sir.7:5, al.); __(b) trans., to invent, devise cleverly: pass., 2Pe.1:16 (cf. κατα-σοφίζομαι).† (AS)

I am poured out or offered as a libation
1787.lxx: in LXX chiefly for נָסַךְ hi.
1787.full: σπένδω [in LXX chiefly for נָסַךְ hi. ;] to pour out as a drink-offering, make a libation; pass., figuratively, σπένδομαι, I am poured out or offered as a libation (in the shedding of my life-blood): Php.2:17 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti.4:6 (for exx. from π., see Milligan, Selections, 114 f.; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

1789.full: τοί-νυν an inferential particle, [in LXX: Isa.3:10 5:13 27:4, Wis.1:11 8:9, a1. * ;] accordingly, therefore: as in cl., after the first word in a sentence, 1Co.9:26; accusative to later usage, at the beginning, Luk.20:25, Heb.13:13.† (AS)

1790.full: 1. a kettledrum , such as was used especially in the worship of Cybele, (Herdotus Historicus) 2. a drum-stick : generally, a staff, cudgel , (Aristophanes Comicus) 3. in Virgil tympana are wheels of solid wood. (ML)

1791.full: φύλλον, -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for עָלֶה ;] a leaf: Mat.21:19 24:32, Mrk.11:13 13:28, Rev.22:2.† (AS)

1793.full: ψωμίζω (ψωμός, a morsel), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל hi. ;] to feed with morsels (as children or the sick; Hippocr.), hence, generally, in late writers, to feed, nourish: with accusative of person(s), Rom.12:20 (LXX); with accusative of thing(s), to give out for food, 1Co.13:3 (cf. WM, § 32, 4an; for dupl. accusative, cf. Num.11:4, Sir.15:3, al.).† (AS)

1795.lxx: in LXX (Jer.28:6, Psa.58:1, al.) chiefly for אָמֵן and cogn. forms

1796.full: ἀν-άπτω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;] to kindle: Luk.12:49, Jas.3:5 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

1798.full: ἐλεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἐλέγχω), [in LXX: Psa.38:14 39:11 (תּוֹכֵחָה), Sir.20:29 21:6 41:4, al. ;] reproof: 2Ti.3:16.† ἔλεγχος, -ου, ὁ (AS)

1799.lxx: in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc.
1799.full: ἐνθυμέομαι, -οῦμαι (θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;] to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.1:20 9:4.† (AS)
